observations:
Torah #76 is a tightly structured teaching built around one central metaphor (vision/ראיה) with a single polarity axis (gadlut/goodness vs. katnut/judgment). All bechina-language concepts in the source text fall within the three packages already defined in torah_76_packages.json. Detailed examination of the nine additions flagged in torah_76_additions.json confirms that each belongs naturally to one of the three existing packages:

(1) Package 1 (הסתכלות / vision cluster) absorbs: ידיעה, חידוש המוח, ידיעת השכל, כלי/גבול וזמן, עיני כל אליך ישברו, צמאון — all are aspects of the vision/seeing domain (either as dimensions of what seeing IS, or as the absence of vision in the case of צמאון).

(2) Package 2 (קטנות המחין / constrained mind) requires no new additions from the source text — it is fully covered by the dataset nodes.

(3) Package 3 (גדלות המחין / expanded mind) absorbs: שכל צח, זרע אברהם אוהבי, מוחא חיורא — all are names/aspects of the luminous, love-sourced, expanded mind.

The two candidate clusters that could potentially form independent packages were examined:

--- Candidate A: צמאון / unregulated thirst ---
Lines 8-9 use bechina language for צמאון (spiritual thirst/unguided longing). With its mirror concept ראיה (vision with limits) it forms a 2-node opposition. However, 2 nodes do not meet the threshold of 3+ concepts for a new package, and צמאון is the negative face of the vision/הסתכלות domain — not an independent conceptual domain. The pair צמאון ↔ ראיה is the internal evil/good mirror of Package 1, not a new package.

--- Candidate B: Renewal/intellect triad ---
Lines 10, 12, 20 contain bechina statements about חידוש המוח, ידיעת השכל, שכל צח, מוחא חיורא, זרע אברהם אוהבי. This is 5 concepts with explicit bechina language. Do they form an independent domain not covered by existing packages? No — because all five are explicitly linked by the Rebbe as bechinot of ראיה (Package 1) or as aspects of גדלות המחין (Package 3). The Rebbe explicitly states 'חידוש המוח הוא בחינת ראיה' (connecting it to Package 1) and 'שכלו צח הוא בגדלות המחין' (connecting it to Package 3). These concepts enrich the existing packages; they do not constitute an independent domain. An independent domain would require concepts that do NOT reduce to the existing packages — and here every concept explicitly reduces to either ראיה or גדלות המחין.

Conclusion: Torah #76 contains exactly 3 packages. The teaching's conceptual architecture is: one structural mechanism (ראיה/הסתכלות) ↔ one negative pole (קטנות/דין/אלהים) ↔ one positive pole (גדלות/אהבה/אברהם). There is no fourth domain.
